Angular · A04 · Bearer is the access token; refresh only on 401
Access proves the caller. Refresh stays off APIs.
API issues tokens. Angular stores access. API validates.
Login, store, interceptor, then the Device API.
★ Backend still validates signature and lifetime.
One refresh in flight. Failure goes to login.
Refresh token is not Authorization for /devices.

text.tspan: Refresh is not a Bearer for APIs.

svg.text: Same JWT story as JwtBearer on the API.

text.tspan: Walk login → store → Bearer → API validate
